narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think l plus l plus b plus b is four times l times b. There are four letters.
<bookmark mark='s1'/>Try l as five and b as six.
<bookmark mark='s2'/>Adding the four sides gives twenty two, but four times five times six is one hundred and twenty.
<bookmark mark='s3'/>Adding a letter twice gives two times that letter, not a product of letters.
